name: godot-claude-mcp
description: Headless-first MCP server for Godot 4.4+: check, scene editing, API docs, tests and playtesting.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --outfile=dist/godot-mcp.mjs --legal-comments=inline --banner:js="// godot-claude MCP server (bundled). Source: server/src. Rebuild: npm run build"
